item.title: LX Semicon starts mass producing automotive MCU for Hyundai Motor, Kia
item.summary: LX Semicon has begun mass production of an automotive microcontroller unit (MCU) and started supplying the chip to Hyundai Motor and Kia, marking the first time the two automakers will use a South Korean-made MCU in vehicles. The move also marks LX Semicon's first mass-production achievement in automotive MCUs, expanding its business beyond the display driver ICs for which it is best known.
